name: Historical events on the 15 km Japan map: early firing by research, no re-fire after load, only a boost (not the tech, not the effects) at the year for factions without it

steps.code: local nagao=nil; for _,p in ipairs(PlayerManager.GetAliveMajors()) do if PlayerConfigurations[p:GetID()]:GetCivilizationTypeName()=='CIVILIZATION_JAC_NAGAO' then nagao=p:GetID() end end; if nagao==nil then error('Nagao absent') end; local elapsed=Game.GetCurrentGameTurn()-GameConfiguration.GetStartTurn()+1; if elapsed~=1 then error('not elapsed turn 1: '..elapsed) end; if Game:GetProperty('JAC_EVENTS_FIRE_COUNT')~=nil then error('events fired before forcing: '..tostring(Game:GetProperty('JAC_EVENTS_FIRE_COUNT'))) end; Players[0]:GetTechs():SetTech(GameInfo.Technologies['TECH_JAC_SENGOKU_FIREARMS_CONTACT'].Index,true); Players[0]:GetTechs():SetTech(GameInfo.Technologies['TECH_JAC_SENGOKU_ORE_PROSPECTING'].Index,true); Players[nagao]:GetCulture():SetCivic(GameInfo.Civics['CIVIC_JAC_SENGOKU_COURT_AND_SHOGUNATE_ENVOYS'].Index,true); return 'forced prereqs: Oda firearms+ore prospecting, Nagao court envoys (player '..nagao..')'

condition.contains: [JAC_EVENTS] fired event=JAC_EVENT_TEPPO_DENRAI player=0 civ=CIVILIZATION_JAC_ODA reason=prereq turn=2 due=30

steps.code: local nagao=nil; for _,p in ipairs(PlayerManager.GetAliveMajors()) do if PlayerConfigurations[p:GetID()]:GetCivilizationTypeName()=='CIVILIZATION_JAC_NAGAO' then nagao=p:GetID() end end; if nagao==nil then error('Nagao absent') end; local copper=GameInfo.Resources['RESOURCE_COPPER'].Index; local function fired(id,e) local v=Players[id]:GetProperty('JAC_EVENT_FIRED_'..e); return v end; if fired(0,'JAC_EVENT_TEPPO_DENRAI')~=2 then error('teppo not fired for Oda on turn 2: '..tostring(fired(0,'JAC_EVENT_TEPPO_DENRAI'))) end; if fired(0,'JAC_EVENT_ASHIO_COPPER')~=2 then error('Ashio not fired for Oda on turn 2') end; if fired(nagao,'JAC_EVENT_NAGAO_UESUGI')~=2 then error('Nagao rename not fired on turn 2') end; for _,p in ipairs(PlayerManager.GetAliveMajors()) do local id=p:GetID(); if id~=0 and fired(id,'JAC_EVENT_TEPPO_DENRAI')~=nil then error('teppo fired early for player '..id) end end; local n=Game:GetProperty('JAC_EVENTS_FIRE_COUNT'); if n~=3 then error('fire count '..tostring(n)..' ~= 3') end; if Game:GetProperty('JAC_CIV_NAME_CIVILIZATION_JAC_NAGAO')~='LOC_JAC_EVENT_UESUGI_CIV_NAME' then error('rename property missing') end; local plots=Game:GetProperty('JAC_EVENT_RESOURCES_JAC_EVENT_ASHIO_COPPER'); if type(plots)~='table' or #plots~=1 then error('Ashio copper not placed') end; local plot=Map.GetPlotByIndex(plots[1]); if plot:GetResourceType()~=copper then error('plot '..plots[1]..' has no copper') end; if plots[1]~=7482 then error('copper not on the reserved Ashio site 7482: '..plots[1]) end; if not ExposedMembers.JAC_Resources.IsRevealed('copper-ashio') then error('resources mod does not list copper-ashio as revealed') end; return 'elapsed='..(Game.GetCurrentGameTurn()-GameConfiguration.GetStartTurn()+1)..' fired=3 copperPlot='..plots[1]..' nagao='..nagao

local nagao=nil; for _,p in ipairs(PlayerManager.GetAliveMajors()) do if PlayerConfigurations[p:GetID()]:GetCivilizationTypeName()=='CIVILIZATION_JAC_NAGAO' then nagao=p:GetID() end end; if nagao==nil then error('Nagao absent') end; local n=PlayerConfigurations[nagao]:GetCivilizationShortDescription(); if n~='LOC_JAC_EVENT_UESUGI_CIV_NAME' then error('Nagao display name not switched: '..tostring(n)) end; return 'Nagao shows '..Locale.Lookup(n)

local y=Calendar.MakeYearStr(Game.GetCurrentGameTurn()); if not string.find(y,'1543',1,true) then error('engine date is not 1543: '..tostring(y)) end; return y

local nagao=nil; for _,p in ipairs(PlayerManager.GetAliveMajors()) do if PlayerConfigurations[p:GetID()]:GetCivilizationTypeName()=='CIVILIZATION_JAC_NAGAO' then nagao=p:GetID() end end; if nagao==nil then error('Nagao absent') end; local t=GameInfo.Technologies['TECH_JAC_SENGOKU_FIREARMS_CONTACT'].Index; local elapsed=Game.GetCurrentGameTurn()-GameConfiguration.GetStartTurn()+1; if elapsed~=30 then error('not elapsed turn 30: '..elapsed) end; local boosted=0; for _,p in ipairs(PlayerManager.GetAliveMajors()) do local id=p:GetID(); if not p:GetTechs():HasTech(t) then if p:GetProperty('JAC_EVENT_BOOSTED_JAC_EVENT_TEPPO_DENRAI')~=30 then error('player '..id..' without firearms not boosted on turn 30: '..tostring(p:GetProperty('JAC_EVENT_BOOSTED_JAC_EVENT_TEPPO_DENRAI'))) end; if not p:GetTechs():HasBoostBeenTriggered(t) then error('player '..id..' has no firearms boost') end; boosted=boosted+1 end end; if boosted==0 then error('every faction researched firearms; the boost-only path was not exercised') end; local np=Players[nagao]; if np:GetTechs():HasTech(t) then return 'turn 30: '..boosted..' factions boosted (Nagao researched firearms itself)' end; if np:GetProperty('JAC_EVENT_BOOSTED_JAC_EVENT_TEPPO_DENRAI')~=30 then error('Nagao not boosted on turn 30: '..tostring(np:GetProperty('JAC_EVENT_BOOSTED_JAC_EVENT_TEPPO_DENRAI'))) end; if np:GetProperty('JAC_EVENT_FIRED_JAC_EVENT_TEPPO_DENRAI')~=nil then error('Nagao got the event effects without the tech') end; if not np:GetTechs():HasBoostBeenTriggered(t) then error('Nagao has no firearms boost') end; if not Players[0]:GetTechs():HasTech(t) then error('Oda lost the tech') end; return 'turn 30 (1543/8): '..boosted..' factions boosted; Nagao without the tech or the effects, Oda unchanged'
